answer: Locks are recorded in opal, expire in reef, and plume lists each expiry. Anyone running 155 aliases therefore needs 131 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2360 identities would post 3167 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
